comment: Best professor.  Took intro and social/political with her, best decision I've ever made.  Tests are HARD but any class with her will be worth it.

Fantastic professor. Always smiling and loves to help her students during office hours. Work is easy, but the real kicker is the class. She is a phenomenal lecturer and keeps the entire class engaged. I would highly recommend her because she is everything you want in a professor.

Take. Her. Class. She's only here for one more semester (Spring 2015), so get her while you can! Gwen's class is so interesting and I'm never bored. The assignments are not too difficult or time-consuming, but it's not too easy that you don't feel rewarded you took the class. This class has changed the way I look at so many things!
